div.head: Wl art 4
div.ab: Et omnis Francigena qui, tempore regis Eadwardi propinqui mei, fuit in Anglia particeps consuetudinum Anglorum, quod ipsi dicunt on hlóte et an scóte, persolvatur secundum legem Anglorum. Hoc decretum sancitum est in Civitate Claudia.

But every Frenchman who, in the time of King Edward, my kinsman, was admitted to the status of an Englishman, which they call being "in lot and in scot," shall be paid for according to English law. This decree was enacted at Gloucester.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 238–239 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
